CancelTask.description_en: Cancels a task that is currently being executed on a cloud phone
CancelTask.description_zh: 取消云手机当前正在执行的任务

CopyImage.description_en: Copies a custom image from the current region to a destination region
CopyImage.description_zh: 将当前地域的自定义镜像拷贝至目标地域

CreateImage.description_en: Creates a custom image for a cloud phone
CreateImage.description_zh: 创建一份云手机自定义镜像

DeleteInstances.description_en: Deletes cloud phone instances in batches

DeleteKeyPairs.description_en: Deletes one or more cloud phone key pairs
DeleteKeyPairs.description_zh: 删除一对或者多对云手机密钥对

FetchFile.description_en: Pulls a file from a cloud phone and saves it to Object Storage Service (OSS)
FetchFile.description_zh: 从云手机拉取文件并保存到OSS

ImportImage.description_en: Imports a local image to Cloud Phone as a custom image in the specified region
ImportImage.description_zh: 导入一份您的本地镜像到云手机，作为自定义镜像出现在相应地域中

ImportKeyPair.description_en: Imports the public key portion of an RSA key pair generated by another tool
ImportKeyPair.description_zh: 导入由其他工具产生的RSA密钥对的公钥部分

InstallApplication.description_en: Installs an application on a cloud phone

ListImageSharePermission.description_en: Queries the list of users with whom a custom image has been shared
ListImageSharePermission.description_zh: 查询自定义镜像已经共享的用户列表

ListImages.description_en: Queries image resources that are available to you
ListImages.description_zh: 查询您可以使用的镜像资源

ListInstanceTypes.description_en: Queries the list of cloud phone instance types

ListInstanceVncUrl.description_en: Queries the web management terminal URL of a cloud phone instance
ListInstanceVncUrl.description_zh: 查询一台云手机实例的Web管理终端地址

ListInstances.description_en: Queries a list of cloud phone instances

ListKeyPairs.description_en: Queries one or more key pairs
ListKeyPairs.description_zh: 查询一个或多个密钥对

ListRegions.description_en: Queries the regions where Cloud Phone is available for purchase

ListTagKeys.description_en: Queries a list of tag keys

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags bound to multiple cloud resources
ListTagResources.description_zh: 查询多个云资源绑定的标签列表

ListTagValues.description_en: Queries the tag values that correspond to a specified tag key
ListTagValues.description_zh: 查询指定标签键对应的标签值

ListTasks.description_en: Retrieves the current task list of a cloud phone instance
ListTasks.description_zh: 获取云手机实例当前任务列表

ListZones.description_en: Queries the list of zones supported in a specified region
ListZones.description_zh: 查询指定地域支持的可用区列表

RenewInstances.description_en: Renews multiple subscription Cloud Phone instances in a batch
RenewInstances.description_zh: 云手机预付费实例批量续费接口

ResetInstances.description_en: Resets instances to their initial state at the time of creation
ResetInstances.description_zh: 初始化实例到创建时的初始状态

RunCommand.description_en: Executes a command on cloud phones

RunInstances.description_en: Creates and starts instances in a batch

SendFile.description_en: Pushes a file to a cloud phone

StopInstances.description_en: Stops multiple instances in a batch

TagResources.description_en: Creates and attaches tags to multiple cloud resources at a time
TagResources.description_zh: 为多个云资源统一创建并绑定标签

UntagResources.description_en: Unbinds tags from multiple cloud resources at a time
UntagResources.description_zh: 为多个云资源统一解绑标签

UpdateImageAttribute.description_en: Modifies the name and description of a custom image and manages the sharing permissions of the image
UpdateImageAttribute.description_zh: 修改一份自定义镜像的名称和描述信息，以及管理镜像的共享权限

UpdateInstanceAttribute.description_en: Modifies the attributes of a cloud phone instance
